{{Top|leg}}
An '''isolation suit''' was a sealed suit used to protect individuals from airborne diseases or contaminants. [[Trig Longo|Trig]] and [[Kale Longo]] saw a guard wearing such a suit run past their cell onboard the [[Imperial prison barge]] [[Purge (prison barge)|''Purge'']]. The guard's suit integrity was compromised near the neck and he was [[Blood/Legends|bleeding]] from a wound at the breech. Kale noted this sighting in a letter "to" their deceased father, [[Von Longo]].
